in_hebrew.name: Archibold
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Archibold הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Archibold is derived from Old English words arce (ruler, power) and bold (bold, brave). This name was originally a variation of the name Arnold or Archibald, both of which mean 'ruler of the people' or 'bold ruler'. Historically, the name has been borne by numerous powerful leaders, including Archibald Campbell, 5th Earl of Argyll, and Archibald Cockburn, 1st Baronet.
